description: This file defines the 'Subunit' class, an entity representing a organizational subunit with ORM mappings using Doctrine in a Human Resource Management System. It implements nested set hierarchy management and includes properties such as id, name, unitId, description, lft, rgt, level, and node, along with corresponding getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: Entity class mapped to 'ohrm_subunit' table, representing a hierarchical subunit with properties for ID, name, unit ID, description, and nested set management fields.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the subunit.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the subunit.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subunit.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subunit.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID associated with the subunit.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Sets the unit ID associated with the subunit.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the subunit.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the subunit.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the 'left' value for nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the 'left' value for nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the 'right' value for nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the 'right' value for nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the level of the node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the level of the node in the hierarchy.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Returns the node interface, initializing if null.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Assigns a node interface to this subunit.
